jobs.title: Armed Hospital Security Officer – Campus Patrol
jobs.description: A reputable healthcare facility in Chicago is seeking an Armed Security Officer to provide protection for persons and property. The role includes conducting patrols, responding to emergencies, and maintaining safety standards. jobs.title: Armed Security Officer: Campus Patrol with Smart Tools
jobs.description:
Allied Universal in Chicago, IL is seeking an armed Security Officer for site patrols at an education location. You will monitor entrances, deter incidents, and provide customer service to students, staff, and visitors while following site procedures.

Requirements include at least 1 year of security experience, an armed guard card or license, and a high school diploma or GED. This full-time role offers a structured schedule and opportunities for growth.

jobs.title: Campus Security Officer - Part-Time Patrol
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is recruiting a part-time Security Officer for Chicago, IL. You will patrol and monitor designated areas, assist students, staff, and visitors with directions and information, and uphold a welcoming, safe campus environment.

The role offers a part-time schedule with daytime and evening shifts, including weekends. Previous customer service experience is preferred, and you must meet minimum age and education requirements. Equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Campus Security Patrol Ambassador - Part Time
jobs.description:
Allied Universal serves as a leading security and facility services provider in Chicago. We are seeking a Security Officer Enhanced Part Time Patrol Ambassador to deliver reliable, flexible hours at a designated site with opportunities to pick up extra shifts and increase earnings.

In this role you will perform patrols, monitor access, respond to incidents, and assist campus personnel while maintaining a professional environment and top-notch customer service for students, staff, and visitors.

jobs.title: Campus Security Lead — Patrol, Train & Respond
jobs.description:
City Colleges of Chicago is seeking a security supervisor to direct part-time security officers and assistants, enforcing district policies and campus safety measures. You will ensure posts are staffed, train personnel, and respond to alarms to maintain a secure campus.

The role requires prior police experience or current status as a full-time police officer, with supervisory background preferred and strong communication skills. Must be able to operate security equipment and work varied shifts.

jobs.title: Campus Security Officer - On‑Site, Growth & Benefits
jobs.description:
The New School in New York City is seeking professional Security Officers to guard and protect campus buildings and people. The role requires compliance with all site policies, and you will participate in emergency response activities and safety operations on campus.

A NYS Security Guard License is required, along with at least 3 years of related experience. The position is primarily in-person, reporting to the Security Shift Supervisor.

jobs.title: Night Shift Security Officer – Healthcare Campus
jobs.description:
Ascension Saint Joseph in Chicago, IL seeks a Security Officer for night shift, full-time duties. You will maintain a safe environment, patrol premises, and respond to security threats while ensuring compliance with policies.

Required are a valid driver's license and basic certifications; prior security or related experience is preferred. The facility offers comprehensive benefits and a supportive work culture.

jobs.title: Evening Security Officer — Healthcare Campus
jobs.description: Ascension Health is seeking a Security Staff member for evening shifts in Chicago, IL. A High School diploma or equivalent and a valid driver's license are required, along with preferred certifications like BLS and a Security Guard credential.
